name: eufy-bulk-downloader
description: Bulk download Eufy Security camera clips via a local web UI

scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,green "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.build: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
scripts.start: concurrently --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,green "cd backend && npm start" "cd frontend && npm run preview"
